email_subject: Application - Entry-level Communications Specialist (B2B Social Media Marketing Manager)
email_body:

cover_letter:
Dear Canonical Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Entry-level Communications Specialist (B2B Social Media Marketing Manager) role. Canonical's mission to advance open source, its remote-first culture since 2004, and its commitment to excellence align closely with how I like to work: curious, hands-on, and focused on continuous improvement.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. I also manage CMS publishing in WordPress, keeping content current and aligned with brand voice. This experience has sharpened my ability to prioritise tasks, meet deadlines, and use data to inform content decisions—skills directly relevant to creating and scheduling social content, analysing performance, and supporting audience growth.

As a freelancer, I designed and built baverok.com and mirook.com, implementing structured data, knowledge-graph markup, and llms.txt to improve search visibility. I use AI tools daily for research, content creation, and audits, and I've automated repetitive tasks with Python and MCP integrations. This technical fluency helps me understand developer audiences and craft messaging that resonates across platforms like LinkedIn, YouTube, and Reddit. I'm also comfortable with A/B testing and using analytics to refine campaigns.

I'm fluent in English and enjoy writing copy that drives action. I thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and am eager to learn and contribute to Canonical's communications team. I'm excited about the opportunity to help grow Canonical's social media presence and engage with its global community.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Canonical.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
